kebab_example: aliyun slb create-access-control-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-name rule1 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccessControlList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the ACL
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the ACL. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), and underscores (_). The name of the ACL that you create must be unique within each region
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组名称，长度限制为1~80个字符，只支持中文、字母、数字和半角句号（.）、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）和下划线（_）。访问控制策略组名称必须为地域内唯一
parameters.name: acl_name

parameters.help_en: The IP version. Valid values: ipv4 and ipv6
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组所在的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value must be 0 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

AclId.description_en: The IP version. Valid values: ipv4 and ipv6
